notes: Account: mid-market analytics SaaS, core product has in-app assistant + semantic search
Initial interest via hosted API (fast onboarding). After spike tests they want Dedicated for sustained heavy inference during reports refresh windows.
Primary workload: session-based chat (stateful with KV cache) and periodic reranking jobs across large doc index.
SLOs called out by product team: p95 generation latency <200ms for prompts <512 tokens; sustained throughput target ~50 requests/sec with bursts to 200 for 10m windows.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated predictability but want clear TCO vs hosted (token costs vs reserved GPU amortization).
POC scope agreed: 2-week dedicated POC (small pool) + canary routing exercise + synthetic and small live traffic run. Runbook includes canary percentages, health checks, and rollback triggers.
- Phase A: Canary 10% live traffic to dedicated model-variant v1-quant (7am-7pm weekdays). Monitor latency/cost/error-rate.
- Phase B: Increase to 30% if p95 latency <200ms and error-rate <0.5% for 24h.
- Full cutover to 100% after 7-day stability window OR manual sign-off.

- Fallbacks: primary routing -> if model variant exceeds error threshold, shift to thinner quant variant (v1-8bit) automatically; if region-wide degradation detected, failover to us-east dedicated pool and/or hosted API route as last-resort.
- Rollback criteria: sustained error-rate >1% for 30m OR p95 latency >350ms for 15m. Rollback is automated with alert to SE/AE and canary stopped.
Security and compliance: they need SSO (SAML), audit logs for token-level requests for 90 days, KMS integration for key rotation, and an option to pin data residency to US only.

On quantization: Engineering asked about recommended quant profiles for their reranking model — SE suggested 8-bit dynamic quant and showed Optimize savings simulation (estimated 30% token compute savings).
Notes from customer: 'Main risk is the peering window — infra team can't open new peering for 2 weeks. Can we run partial POC over VPN first?'
Open questions: exact throughput pricing for reserved pool with burst credits; SLA for cross-region failover; observability hooks for tracing requests through fallback paths.
Quote from product lead: 'We need predictable tails; if we can get p95 under 200ms across workloads and a clean rollback story, we'll move to committed capacity.'
Sales ask: draft two procurement options — 1) 12-month reserved pool with moderate burst, 2) 6-month pilot with conversion credits. Include Optimize recommendations in cost model.
SE action items: deliver POC runbook, provide firewall/peering checklist, create cost comparison sheet with actual projected token counts, schedule week-of-03-16 canary run with customer infra.
